query:
SELECT
                id,
                left(split_part(btrim(request), E'\n', 1), $6) AS "title!",
                flow,
                created_at,
                outcome,
                ended_at
            FROM factory_run
            WHERE user_id = $1
              AND created_at >= $2
              AND created_at < $3
              AND ($4::text IS NULL OR flow = $4)
            ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
            LIMIT $5
